component.name: Ollama GUI
component.summary: Chat with your local Ollama models

description.p: A native GTK4 and libadwaita desktop client for Ollama. Talk to models running on your own machine, keep conversations on disk, and read replies with native markdown and code rendering.

ul.li: Streaming chat with stop and token-per-second stats
Local conversation history stored in SQLite
Model picker and per-chat model selection
Temperature, context size, and system prompt settings
Markdown, tables, lists, and syntax-highlighted code blocks

description.p: Initial release: streaming chat, persistence, settings, and markdown rendering.
